title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 20: Pashhur puts Jeremiah in the stocks, the new name Magormissabib, and the prophet's own complaint.

questions.text: Who struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks?
questions.explanation: Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, was chief officer in Yahweh's house, and he struck Jeremiah and put him in the stocks.

questions.text: Where were the stocks in which Jeremiah was put?
questions.explanation: The stocks were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh's house.

answers.text: In the court of the king's house
At the potter's gate outside the city
In the upper gate of Benjamin

questions.text: After he was released, Jeremiah told Pashhur that Yahweh had called his name something else. What name?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that Yahweh had not called his name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

questions.text: According to verse 4, what did Yahweh say Pashhur would become to himself and to all his friends?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends."

questions.text: According to verse 5, what would be given into the hand of the enemies and carried away?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would give all the riches of the city, all its gains, all its precious things and all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies, who would carry them to Babylon.

answers.text: The riches and treasures of the city and of Judah's kings
The flocks and herds of the shepherds
The books written by all the prophets
The ships and the goods of the merchants

questions.text: Where did Yahweh say Pashhur would die and be buried?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that Pashhur and all who dwelt in his house would go into captivity, and that he would come to Babylon, and there die and be buried.

questions.text: What did the speaker say he had become all day long?
questions.explanation: He said he had become a laughingstock all day, and that everyone mocked him.

answers.text: A guest at the king's table

questions.text: What happened in the speaker's heart when he decided not to speak any more in Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: He said that there was in his heart as it were a burning fire shut up in his bones, and he was weary with holding it in and could not.

answers.text: A burning fire shut up in his bones
A dream that he had to tell

questions.text: In the call to sing and praise Yahweh, what reason is given?
questions.explanation: The text says to sing to Yahweh and praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

answers.text: He has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers
He has given rain upon the land in its season
He has made a covenant with all the priests
He has brought the captives back from Babylon

questions.text: What did the speaker call cursed near the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: He said, "Cursed is the day in which I was born," and also called cursed the man who brought his father the news that a boy was born to him.

answers.text: The city that rejected his words
The gate where he was put in the stocks
The prophets who lied in Yahweh's name
